_help: Answer key for ONE capture. Copy to eval/captures/lab/<capture-name>.truth.json (same base name as the .pcapng). Delete every _help key when done. Unknown value = null (never guess). Full instructions: eval/CAPTURE_GUIDE.md section 6. Check with: python eval/check_capture.py <capture>.pcapng --truth <capture>.truth.json
_help_top: simulated: true for simulator/test-server traffic (CAPTURE_GUIDE section 4). site_data: none | anonymised (docs/ethics.md). Both stay at the top level.

capture._help: Who/when/where. Not scored, but we need it for the paper.
capture.method: SPAN port on switch X, port N mirrored to port M | capture on the engineering PC | VM host-only network

devices._help: One entry per device the tool should list. id = IP, or IP/u<unit> for a Modbus unit behind a gateway, or IP/slot<n> for a module in a backplane slot reached through a comms card.

source._help: Where you read each value (label photo file name, web page, TIA Portal Online & diagnostics, RSLinx Device Properties ...). Not scored.
